bodyHtml:
🌐 Custom Website Design · Logan & Surrounds

New Website Design Logan. Built To Convert Visitors Into Customers.

A professional website isn't a luxury, it's a necessity. Whether you're a small business owner, a startup, or a solo tradie, your website is often the first impression people have of your brand. Computer Repairs Logan helps you make that impression count with affordable, professional website creation designed to showcase your business and convert visitors into customers.

Build My Website
✓ Technicians & Designers
✓ Mobile-First Builds
✓ SEO Built In
✓ Ongoing Support Options
Why It Matters

Your Website Is Often The First Impression.

A professional website isn't a luxury, it's a necessity. Whether you're a small business owner, a startup, or a solo tradie, your website is often the first thing people see of your brand, so it needs to work as hard as you do.

Our Approach

Built With You, Not Just For You.

Computer Repairs Logan offers affordable, professional website creation designed to showcase your business and convert visitors into customers. We're technicians and designers, so you get someone who can solve backend issues and design an appealing, user-friendly interface, not just a pretty template.

What's Included

Everything Your New Website Needs, Built In.

🎨

Custom Design & Branding

A fully branded website based on your logo, colour scheme and tone of voice, with a clean, modern layout and easy navigation.

📱

Responsive, Mobile-First Design

Optimised for desktops, laptops, tablets and phones, with speed-optimised load times and mobile-friendly menus and buttons.

🧑‍💻

WordPress & CMS Setup

Built on easy-to-use platforms like WordPress so you can update your site without needing a developer, with full CMS training included.

🔍

SEO Built In From Day One

On-page SEO including metadata, header structure, image compression and schema markup, plus keyword strategy for your industry and niche.

🛒

E-Commerce & Online Booking

Booking forms or scheduling tools for service businesses, online shops via WooCommerce or Shopify, and integration with Stripe, PayPal or Afterpay.

🔐

Security & Backups

Secure password protocols and login protection, backups configured through hosting or plugins, and SSL certificate setup.

Who Is This Service For?

Built For Real Logan Businesses.

  • Small businesses. Needing a professional online presence.
  • Tradies. Wanting job enquiries through a contact form.
  • Local cafés and restaurants. Wanting a digital menu or online orders.
  • Freelancers or sole traders. Needing a personal portfolio or landing page.
  • Tutors and educators. Offering bookings or digital content.
  • Retailers. Looking to launch an online store or showcase products.
What Makes A Good Website In 2026?

The Principles We Build Every Site Around.

  • Fast load times. Nobody waits around for a slow site.
  • Trust indicators. ABN, reviews, certifications, visibly displayed.
  • Mobile-first experience. Most visitors land on a phone.
  • Easy to update. You shouldn't need a developer for text changes.
  • Clear calls to action. Book Now, Buy Now, Contact Us, front and centre.
  • Optimised for search engines. See our dedicated SEO service for ongoing ranking work.
Optional Add-Ons

Pair Your New Site With The Extras That Matter.

💬

Google Business Profile Setup

Get your business showing up correctly in local search and maps.

🔍

SEO Keyword Research

Local listing optimisation and keyword research tailored to your industry.

🖼️

Logo Design Or Refresh

See our full logo, pamphlet & business card design service.

📧

Domain & Custom Email

A professional address that matches your new site, see domain & custom email setup.

Related Services

Everything Around Your New Site.

Need somewhere reliable to host it? See our web hosting service. Already have a site that just needs freshening up instead of a full rebuild? Check our redesigns & updates page. And once it's live, our SEO services help people actually find it.

Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions, Answered.

Do I need to have all my content ready before you start building?

Not at all. We can help you create or organise your website copy, images and layout during the planning stage, and guide you on what's needed for a content-rich business website.

What's included in your basic small business website package?

The standard package includes up to 5 pages (e.g. Home, About, Services, Blog, Contact), responsive design, basic SEO setup, a contact form, and onsite setup support. Get in touch for a free quote tailored to your business.

Can you integrate my existing logo and branding into the website?

Yes, we'll build your site to match your visual identity, including logo, colours, typography and existing marketing materials.

What platforms do you build websites on?

We primarily build on WordPress, but can also work with Shopify, Webflow and Squarespace depending on your business goals.

Do you offer website hosting as well?

Yes, see our dedicated web hosting page for details, or we can guide you through reliable, Australian-based hosting with a trusted provider.

Can you help redesign an old website that no longer performs?

Yes, see our website redesigns & updates service to update outdated layouts, improve speed, and optimise for SEO and mobile responsiveness.

Ready To Launch Your New Website?

Book a free discovery visit and let's plan a site that actually works for your business.

Build My Website
